tytul: Apricot jam with apricot kernels: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for apricot jam with added apricot kernels (the almond-like seeds inside the stones).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Amygdalin is the main cyanogenic glycoside in apricot kernels, and it breaks down to cyanide. EFSA estimates that a toddler can eat only 0.06 g and an adult only 0.37 g of raw apricot kernels without going over the acute reference dose for cyanide.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no data on how much of this toxin is left in jam.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for apricot jam with kernels from a checked source.
JarAtlas has a card for apricot jam without added pectin, made without kernels.
